# Ritual Agent Defense IDE Extension
> Unified AI Agent Runtime Defense & Kernel Sandbox for Cursor, VS Code, and Windsurf

Ritual Agent Defense is the official IDE extension bringing real-time kernel sandbox telemetry, DBShield wire proxy mutation approval queue, and SkillPrism token savings visualizer directly into the code editor.

Website: https://ritualdev.in/extension/
Open VSX: https://open-vsx.org/extension/ritualdev-lab/ritual-agent-defense
Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/ritual-agent-defense
License: MIT

## Installation
```bash
# Install via VS Code / Cursor CLI
code --install-extension ritualdev-lab.ritual-agent-defense

# Or install in Cursor
cursor --install-extension ritualdev-lab.ritual-agent-defense
```

## Integrated Capabilities
1. **Live Status Bar Telemetry**: Monitors active AgentShield kernel sandbox profile (Bubblewrap / Landlock / Seatbelt / AppContainer) and displays network egress lock status.
2. **1-Click Mutation Approval Queue**: Editor side panel streams incoming agent database mutations and high-risk terminal commands for 1-click human verification.
3. **SkillPrism Token Savings Visualizer**: Tracks real-time context compaction and cumulative dollar savings across model turns.
4. **DevShelf Embedded Tool Browser**: Instant search across 565+ verified MCP servers directly from the IDE.
